audience: developers and support teams who run in-app chat with Sendbird

useCases.title: Find chat users by nickname or id
useCases.text: The AI lists users filtered by nickname, ids, activity or metadata and opens one user's profile.

useCases.title: See which channels a user is in
useCases.text: The AI lists the group channels of a given user and the members of a channel. You can check who talks where.

useCases.title: Read the latest messages of a channel
useCases.text: The AI lists messages in a channel from a timestamp or message id and sums up the conversation, such as a support channel.

useCases.title: Browse open channels
useCases.text: The AI lists open (public) channels and opens one by its URL to read its details.

useCases.title: Create users and group channels, update users, send messages
useCases.text: The AI creates a user or a group channel with the members you name, updates a user's profile, and sends a message as a user or an admin.
